lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Sun dips low behind the ridge
Shadows stretch across the rusted bridge
You're sitting by the weeping willow tree
The amber light is all that I can see
[chorus]
It's the golden hour calling us back home
Underneath the willow where the wild things roam
Dust settles soft on your woolen sleeves
Whispering secrets through the falling leaves
[verse]
The creek is humming tunes from yesterday
Turning all the silver into shades of gray
I trace the branches bent against the sky
Watching the daylight heave a quiet sigh
[chorus]
It's the golden hour calling us back home
Underneath the willow where the wild things roam
Dust settles soft on your woolen sleeves
Whispering secrets through the falling leaves
[bridge]
Time doesn't move when you're anchored here
The world feels distant, the vision clear
Just the bark and the roots and the evening glow
Everything we need is what we already know
[chorus]
It's the golden hour calling us back home
Underneath the willow where the wild things roam
Dust settles soft on your woolen sleeves
Whispering secrets through the falling leaves
[outro]
